candidate.rationale: Restore surrogate-pair handling removed by the slice-bounds mutation: reject an interior start, move an interior end backward before the pair, and keep the no-progress/EOF checks and return fields unchanged.

Replace stringified-JSON equality (key-order sensitive and fails on nested structure edge cases) with isDeepStrictEqual on parsed values, so object member order is not semantic while array order, value types, and member presence remain significant; preserve response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the export.

Fix retention-tool-pairs mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (instead of mere membership), per inspected requirements.

Restore retention-tool-pair validation: require unique (nonempty) call IDs within each exchange and positional one-to-one matching of each tool result's tool_call_id with the assistant call at the same index, instead of mere membership. Masking semantics, exports, and unrelated behavior are unchanged.

Restore positional tool-result pairing (message.tool_call_id === ids[index]) and enforce call-ID uniqueness within each exchange, per evidence/contract.json requirements that membership alone is insufficient and call IDs must be unique; masking of old entries and all other behavior preserved.

Repair retention-tool-pairs validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not merely membership), per evidence/cases.json cases 9-11 and 13-15; preserve masking behavior for old steps and recent-tail pass-through.

Use isDeepStrictEqual for structural JSON comparison so object member order is ignored while array order, types, and missing/extra members remain significant; preserve response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the exact_json_match/answer_mismatch reasons.

Repair slice-bounds mutation: move an interior end backward before the surrogate pair, reject an interior start, and reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress without splitting a pair; preserve exports, return fields, and EOF-empty-slice behavior.

Restore structural JSON equality: replace stringified comparison (order-sensitive) with isDeepStrictEqual, which ignores object key order while preserving array order, value types, and missing/extra members. Keeps response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the public export unchanged. Tests were not run.

Enforce unique call IDs per exchange and positional one-to-one pairing of tool results with assistant calls, matching cases-08/09/10/11 and the requirements, while preserving exports, masking, and recent-tail behavior.

Repair retention-long-window mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index (instead of mere membership), per inspected requirements; masking still applies only to entries outside the recent tail.
